GAIA Desktop @VERSION@

A desktop application for parsing and building GS1 Application Identifier data — type, paste, open or scan an input and read the result as a report.

Starting it

Java 21 or newer must be installed. This distribution is built for one operating system and processor, so use the one made for your machine.

  • Windows: double-click run.bat.
  • macOS: open GAIA Desktop.app (drag it to Applications first if you like), or run ./run.sh.
  • Linux: run ./run.sh.

Or from a terminal, beside gaia-desktop.jar and its lib/ folder:

java -jar gaia-desktop.jar
java -jar gaia-desktop.jar --language=FR

Guides

User Guide

Parsing, the builder, the report, options, languages, keyboard shortcuts and troubleshooting.

Samples

Sample barcodes to scan or type: one for each GS1 data carrier in Parse mode, and the three GS1-128 barcodes of a legacy label for Combine mode. The barcode images load from barcode.tec-it.com, so the page needs an internet connection.

Zebra Scanner SetupWindows

Installing and configuring a Zebra scanner (tested with the DS8108): Java, the Zebra Scanner SDK, USB mode and GS1 settings, connecting, and troubleshooting.

Developer Guide

Building and packaging, architecture, the {GS} token, the scanner gate, localization, state file formats and testing.

Reading the guides: use a Markdown viewer

The guides are Markdown files (.md). Opened directly in a browser they show as plain text, with the tables, headings and links unformatted, so open them in a Markdown viewer instead. Any of these free options will do:

  • Visual Studio Code (Windows, macOS, Linux): open the .md file and press Ctrl+Shift+V (⌘+Shift+V on macOS) for the preview.
  • A Markdown viewer extension for your browser (Chrome, Edge or Firefox), for example Markdown Viewer. Allow it access to file URLs in the extension's settings, then click a guide's link on this page.
  • A desktop Markdown app, such as Typora, MarkText or Obsidian.

The Samples pages are HTML and open in any browser without a viewer. Links in the Developer Guide that point into the source tree (outside docs/) only work in a source checkout.
